bio: I am a PhD candidate in Soil, Water, and Ecosystem Sciences at the University of Florida, in the Sustainable Tropical Soil Management Lab led by Dr. Márcio R. Nunes. I develop context-aware soil health benchmarks and digital soil maps using Bayesian statistics, interpretable machine learning, and geospatial analysis.

Before UF, I spent thirteen years at Ambo University in Ethiopia teaching GIS and remote sensing, leading research on land use and watersheds, and serving as Head of the Department of Land Administration and Surveying and Dean of the School of Natural Resources.
